(1) Metric arithmetic: nodes/edges/divisions are byte-identical, so N_pred multiplier = 0 and division J = 0 (float output changed no division counts: TP 23/FP 27/FN 122 both ways, r1_research_float-output-coords.json). The only channel is edge J through near-tie flips in the per-frame optimal 1/(1+d) assignment at 7 um; one FN->TP = +7.4e-6 (D = 135,729), so +0.002 needs ~270 net flips. (2) Closest analogue, measured: float output removed ~0.25 um^2 of independent output noise (z rounding 0.47 um RMS). Lab +0.0018, clean on both embryos (44b6 +0.0020, 90% CI [-0.0002,+0.0044]; 6bba +0.0016). LB: exp52 = exp51 = 0.950, a tie. The watershed sits ON TOP of that (the idea keeps the float/safe encoding), on a lower-variance base, and the jitter dose-response is strongly convex (xy width 0.81 -> -0.0003/-0.0009; width 1.625 -> -0.0021/-0.0013; v2 polyphase notes l.7). (3) Reducible variance: head mean error 1.525 um (~2.7 um^2 MSE); a GT-fitted in-sample head floors at 1.21-1.28 (~1.8 um^2). Of the ~0.9 um^2 gap, ~0.39 um^2 is the 6bba bias (z/y/x +0.35-0.46/+0.3/+0.37 um), which is annotation convention: the 6bba->44b6 retrain made 44b6 worse, 1.296 -> 1.452 (coordhead_retrain report). With w=0.4 the residual is 0.36*V_h + 0.16*V_c. Even a perfect centroid captures <= 64% of the ~0.5 um^2 non-convention part (0.32 um^2). A realistic centroid noise V_c 0.5-1 um^2 (touching nuclei in the dense 6bba quartile where the loss sits; 44b6 under-segmentation) leaves a net 0.15-0.25 um^2. That is at most the float-output dose, so lab <= +0.001..+0.0018 and public ~0..+0.001. A watershed/intensity-centroid convention bias b_c (light-sheet z attenuation/PSF; z voxel 1.625 um) adds back 0.16*b_c^2, e.g. +0.10 um^2 at b_c = 0.8 um, which cancels about half. (4) Encoding: the safe encoding w = r + clip(v-r, 0, 0.499) drops negative fractional parts, and a rounding server drops all sub-voxel z. Max z shift 0.6 um = 0.37 z-voxel, so much of the z correction (the axis with the largest error) never reaches the scorer. (5) Transfer record for small GT-free/position tweaks is negative: Eric's sub-voxel refinement lab +0.0078 -> LB -0.002 twice; constant offset -0.0031 LB; Ultrack segment-centroid snap improved the median 1.42 -> 1.22 but lowered the <4 um share 0.927 -> 0.908; GT-free neighbour contraction moved the <4 um share <= 0.0003 (r2_critic notes). The swap-FN oracle (+0.03-0.046) is out of reach: swap offsets are 4.4 um vs a 0.6 um maximum shift. (6) The gate has little power: 44b6 is ONE recording (71 overlapping crops), so the both-embryos gate has n=2, and a null transform with an embryo-random sign passes the sign test 50% of the time. Per-embryo CIs (+-0.002) are wider than the expected effect. LB noise 0.003 = 3x the expected gain, so P(visible LB gain) <= 0.1. The idea's own estimate (0..+0.001 public) already sits below the bar.
